# GSAP 3.15.0

`gsap.min.js`, `ScrollTrigger.min.js` and `Flip.min.js` are unmodified builds of
GSAP by GreenSock (https://gsap.com), self-hosted so the site keeps a strict
`script-src 'self'` Content-Security-Policy.
